dimensions.note: Both methods emit structured entry and successful-completion logs without proposal content.
Malformed input returns stable fail-closed diagnostics; collisions, missing resources, invalid persisted data, rejection, and subject mismatch throw before writes.
Tests cover acceptance, strict malformed input, subject/content tampering, active windows, path and size bounds, zero authority, idempotent replay, ID collisions, and subject-bound assertions.
Same ID and result reuses persisted state without writing; same ID with different content fails closed.
No external handles or temporary resources.
Published examples and fixtures contain only synthetic identifiers and no infrastructure details.
All object contracts are strict; accepted and rejected union branches are discriminated and persisted writes are schema-parsed.
The sole result resource declares infinite lifetime and explicit GC retention.
Decision intake and assertion do not manage an external CRUD lifecycle.
No external mutation or execution method exists.
The sole writer and reader use the same validated intake-<intakeId> identity; collisions cannot overwrite differing results.
Both idempotency and assertion read through context.readResource and strictly validate persisted data.
